# WhatsApp message types — full support guide

`@chaeulso/baileys` supports **every message type in the current WhatsApp protocol schema** for **sending, receiving, serialization and event handling**. Support is **schema‑driven**: the protobuf definition [`WAProto/WAProto.proto`](../WAProto/WAProto.proto) is the source of truth, compiled into `WAProto/index.js`. The parser helpers (`getContentType`, `getMessageContentKeys`, `getMessageTypeInfo`) read **schema keys**, not a hardcoded switch, so **new types WhatsApp introduces work automatically** the moment the published schema is updated.

> Coverage is enforced by [`test/message-types.test.mjs`](../test/message-types.test.mjs), which round‑trips **every top‑level `Message` field** (currently **95**) through encode → decode → detect.

## 1. How messages are modelled

A message you send/receive is a `proto.WebMessageInfo`:

```ts
{
  key: { remoteJid, fromMe, id, participant? },   // addressing
  messageTimestamp,                                // unix seconds
  pushName?, status?, broadcast?,                  // metadata
  message: WAMessageContent                         // ≤ ONE content field (plus metadata keys)
}
```

`WAMessageContent` (`proto.IMessage`) has ~95 possible fields; in practice a message sets **one** (plus optional `messageContextInfo`, `senderKeyDistributionMessage`, and system fields).

The **content type** is whichever of these keys is set. Detect it with:

```ts
import { getContentType } from '@chaeulso/baileys'
const type = getContentType(m.message)  // 'imageMessage' | 'conversation' | 'extendedTextMessage' | ...
```

`getContentType` returns the first key that is `conversation` or ends in `Message` (excluding `senderKeyDistributionMessage`). It is deliberately *generic* — unknown `*Message` keys are returned verbatim.

## 2. Renderable content types (the 86)

These are detected by `getContentType`. Grouped for readability — **all** round‑trip cleanly.

| Category        | Types |
| --------------- | ----- |
| **Text**        | `conversation`, `extendedTextMessage` |
| **Media**       | `imageMessage`, `videoMessage`, `audioMessage`, `documentMessage`, `stickerMessage`, `ptvMessage` (video note), `lottieStickerMessage` |
| **Contact**     | `contactMessage`, `contactsArrayMessage` |
| **Location**    | `locationMessage`, `liveLocationMessage` |
| **Interactive** | `listMessage`, `listResponseMessage`, `buttonsMessage`, `buttonsResponseMessage`, `templateMessage`, `templateButtonReplyMessage`, `interactiveMessage`, `interactiveResponseMessage`, `nativeFlowMessage` (nested), `nativeFlowResponseMessage` (nested) |
| **Polls**       | `pollCreationMessage` (→V5), `pollUpdateMessage`, `pollResultSnapshotMessage` (+V3), `pollCreationOptionImageMessage` |
| **Reactions**   | `reactionMessage`, `encReactionMessage` |
| **Commerce**    | `productMessage` (catalogs), `orderMessage` (orders & order requests), `invoiceMessage`, `paymentInviteMessage`, `sendPaymentMessage`, `requestPaymentMessage`, `declinePaymentRequestMessage`, `cancelPaymentRequestMessage` |
| **Invites/Groups** | `groupInviteMessage`, `groupMentionedMessage`, `newsletterAdminInviteMessage`, `newsletterFollowerInviteMessageV2` |
| **Status/Stories** | `statusMentionMessage`, `groupStatusMessage` (+V2), `statusQuestionAnswerMessage`, `statusQuotedMessage`, `statusStickerInteractionMessage`, `statusNotificationMessage`, `questionMessage`, `questionReplyMessage`, `questionResponseMessage`, `commentMessage`, `encCommentMessage`, `encEventResponseMessage`, `eventMessage`, `scheduledCallCreationMessage`, `scheduledCallEditMessage` |
| **Wrappers**    | `viewOnceMessage`, `viewOnceMessageV2`, `ephemeralMessage`, `editedMessage`, `documentWithCaptionMessage`, `albumMessage`, `associatedChildMessage`, `groupMentionedMessage`, `viewOnceMessageV2Extension` |
| **Bot flows**   | `botInvokeMessage`, `botTaskMessage`, `botForwardedMessage`, `botFeedbackMessage` (where present) |
| **Misc**        | `richResponseMessage`, `highlyStructuredMessage`, `placeholderMessage`, `limitSharingMessage`, `stickerPackMessage`, `stickerSyncRmrMessage`, `secretEncryptedMessage`, `deviceSentMessage`, `requestPhoneNumberMessage`, `keepInChatMessage`, `pinInChatMessage` |

Don't rely on this list as exhaustive-text: read it from the schema (see §7).

## 3. Wrapper types & how to unwrap

Wrapper messages carry another message inside `.message`:

```ts
{
  viewOnceMessage: { message: { imageMessage: {...} } }
}
```

Unwrap to the meaningful content:

```ts
import { normalizeMessageContent, extractMessageContent, getMessageTypeInfo } from '@chaeulso/baileys'

const normalized = normalizeMessageContent(m.message)      // also interprets ephemeral/view-once groups
const inner = extractMessageContent(normalized)            // -> { imageMessage: {...} }

// one-liner descriptor:
const info = getMessageTypeInfo(m.message)
// { outerType:'viewOnceMessage', innerType:'imageMessage', isViewOnce:true, isMedia:true, isEphemeral:false, isEdited:false, protocol:undefined }
```

Detected wrappers: `viewOnceMessage`, `viewOnceMessageV2`, `ephemeralMessage`, `editedMessage`, `documentWithCaptionMessage`, `groupMentionedMessage`, `associatedChildMessage`, `statusQuotedMessage`.

## 4. Attribute-based types: `quotedMessage` & `forwardedMessage`

These are **not** standalone content keys — they're metadata inside `contextInfo` and are **preserved losslessly**:

```ts
const ci = m.message?.extendedTextMessage?.contextInfo
ci?.quotedMessage        // the full quoted message object
ci?.stanzaId, ci?.participant
ci?.isForwarded, ci?.forwardingScore

// send a quoted reply:
await sock.sendMessage(jid, { text: 'reply' }, { quoted: incomingMessage })

// forward an existing message (sets isForwarded/increments forwardingScore):
await sock.sendMessage(jid, { forward: someMessage })
```

## 5. Special cases (honest mapping)

Not everything WhatsApp shows in the UI is a top‑level `Message` field. Here's exactly how each requirement lands:

| Requirement type            | Reality                       | How to use |
| --------------------------- | ----------------------------- | ---------- |
| `nativeFlowMessage`         | **nested** inside `interactiveMessage` / `productMessage` / `carouselMessage` | send an `interactive` message with `nativeFlowMessage` in its body |
| `catalogMessage`            | not a schema field            | catalogs flow through `productMessage` |
| `orderRequestMessage`       | not a schema field            | order requests flow through `orderMessage` |
| `callLogMessage`            | real message type `proto.Message.CallLogMessage`, delivered via call events + history, **not** a sendable top‑level field | read it from history sync / `call` events |
| `disappearingMode`          | chat‑setting message type (`proto.DisappearingMode`) and `ephemeralMessage` carrier | send disappearing via `ephemeralExpiration` option; control with ephemeralMessage |
| `callLogMesssage` (field)   | top‑level system field (note the proto's literal triple‑s spelling) | parse it from history; `getContentType` won't classify it (same as upstream) — detect with `'callLogMesssage' in m.message` |

## 6. System/control fields (9)

These top‑level fields carry protocol/system data (not user content) and round‑trip losslessly, but are **intentionally not** classified by `getContentType`:

`senderKeyDistributionMessage`, `call`, `chat`, `messageContextInfo`, `callLogMesssage`, `messageHistoryBundle`, `eventCoverImage`, `statusAddYours`, `messageHistoryNotice`.

Detect them explicitly:

```ts
if ('senderKeyDistributionMessage' in m.message) { /* fast ratchet session rotate */ }
if ('call' in m.message) { /* call description */ }
if ('messageContextInfo' in m.message) { /* device list metadata */ }
```

## 7. Enumerate supported types at runtime

Because support is schema‑driven, you can list everything the library can handle programmatically:

```ts
import { proto } from '@chaeulso/baileys'
// every top-level message field name (the supported message-type keys):
const contentTypes = Object.keys(proto.Message.fields || [])  // reflection available on the reflection build
// or simply scan the schema file as the test-suite does (test/helpers.mjs -> getProtoMessageFields)
```

> Tip: When WhatsApp ships new types, update `WAProto/WAProto.proto` + regenerate; every parser/test picks them up without code changes.

## 8. Defensive parsing for untrusted input

Messages arrive over the network — always validate before acting:

```ts
import { isWAMessage, sanitizeIncomingMessage } from '@chaeulso/baileys'

sock.ev.on('messages.upsert', ({ messages }) => {
  for (const raw of messages) {
    const m = sanitizeIncomingMessage(raw)  // returns null for junk
    if (!m) continue                        // drop structurally-invalid packets
    const info = getMessageTypeInfo(m.message)
    // ...
  }
})
```
